hero.heading: Built for the ones|who refuse to blend in
hero.sub: Stay Different started with a simple idea: your hair should look like your personality, not like everyone else's.

story.heading: Hair is|self-expression
story.body:
We grew tired of an industry that sold one look to everyone. The same three shades. The same "safe" textures. The same message: fit in.

So we built the opposite. Stay Different Hair makes premium, 100% human hair in shades with personality and textures that celebrate every curl pattern. We colour and tone in small batches, obsess over hairlines, and test every unit on real people before it reaches you.

Whether you want to blend in beautifully or walk in and change the room, we are here for both. Just do it your way.

values.title: Quality without compromise
values.text: 100% human hair, cuticle-aligned and double-drawn. If we would not wear it, we will not sell it.

values.title: Shades with personality
values.text: Original colours developed in-house and named for the people who wear them.

values.title: Every texture, celebrated
values.text: From bone-straight to kinky coils — no texture is an afterthought.

values.title: Honest help
values.text: Real people on WhatsApp who will tell you which shade actually suits you.
